name: Cheng Bao Yu Mo Suo Ti Si
source:
Prince Pathos, a black lion with a gray mane, lived in a weak island country that believed in the God of the Sea in a medieval-like world. One night after his coming-of-age, he suddenly found gills growing on his neck, which represented a curse and calamity according to his country's legend. As a prince, he fled under impulse and fear to the strait outside of his enemy country. There he encountered a gray wolf...

[Edited from [url=https://yuxiu.itch.io/castle-myosotis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帕托斯王子是一头灰色鬃毛的黑狮，生活在一个信奉海神的中世纪世界的弱岛国。成年后的一天晚上，他突然发现脖子上长出了鳃，根据祖国的传说，这代表着诅咒和灾难。作为王子，他在冲动和恐惧之下逃到了敌国之外的海峡。在那里他遇到了一只灰太狼……
